query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart for the top 8 countries by support-and-adaptation yield per Top-30 city in the 2020 report, where the metric is `(grants_support_initiatives + life_business_adaptation) / number of visible cities ranked 30th or better`, values are expressed as sampled innovations per Top-30 city, only countries with at least one visible city ranked 30th or better are eligible, countries with `city_rankings = unavailable` are excluded, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest.
selection_rule: top 8 after requiring at least one visible Top-30 city

plot_spec.title: 2020 Support-Adaptation Yield per Top-30 City
plot_spec.xlabel: Support + adaptation innovations per Top-30 city
